description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Marketing Manager to guide go-to-market strategy and partner coordination for NVIDIA’s networking product portfolio. In this role, you will connect Product, Sales, Marketing, and our partner ecosystem. You will translate complex technical features into engaging, sales-ready materials and training. This role fits someone who excels at the intersection of GTM orchestration, sales enablement, and partner interaction. It involves managing partner co-marketing initiatives and product launches. It also emphasizes enhancing operational efficiency in product marketing workflows. Success in this position requires equal parts strategic vision and follow-through to align cross-functional teams, balance competing priorities, and consistently meet key deadlines.


What you'll be doing:

  • Building and completing go-to-market plans for internal sales and partner audiences for new products. This includes launch sequencing, partner engagement, sales training, communications, partner co-marketing asset creation, and cross-functional implementation.
  • Driving alignment and collaboration across Product, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, and external partner collaborators to ensure coordinated GTM execution.
  • Orchestrating cross-functional partner launch plans, coordinating efforts among Product Management, Partner Marketing, Sales, and Product Marketing to secure seamless execution.
  • Be responsible for the event engagement with key partners including product launch coordination, content, social engagement and product demonstrations.
  • Building high-impact sales enablement assets such as training decks, one-pagers, return on investment tools, and case studies, translating complex technical features into clear, value-focused messaging for NVIDIA and partner sales teams.
  • Managing the creation, upkeep, and oversight of the sales asset library. Work closely with Product Management and Technical Marketing to keep all materials updated, consistent with the brand, and suited to the accurate sales stage.
  • Inventing and deliver sales training for the networking product portfolio. Partner with Field Enablement and Product Management to develop curriculum addressing product positioning, technical differentiation, competitive handling, and demo standards. Maintain ongoing updates aligned with product developments.
  • Managing sales communication channels such as salescasts and email blasts. Collaborate with Product Marketing and Field Enablement to provide valuable content to the field promptly and regularly.

What we need to see:

  • 8+ years of experience with a proven history in product marketing and launching strategies, sales enablement, and partner strategy within a rapidly evolving technology company.
  • Domain Expertise: Working knowledge of data center and networking technologies and how they relate to AI and enterprise solutions.
  • Enablement & Content Tools: Experience using repositories and creation tools like Highspot, Google Slides, Power Point, Google Docs, and/or similar content management suites.
  • Communication: Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology capabilities into clear, simple positioning and messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Agility: Proven track record prioritizing multiple projects and work independently with minimal direction in a highly complex, agile environment.
  • Education: Bachelors degree or equivalent experience in Business Management, Marketing or a related technical field.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Familiarity with, or previous exposure to, NVIDIA's Networking solutions, products, and ecosystem.
  • Mastery in storytelling and outstanding content development skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives for any audience.
  • Excellent understanding of marketing frameworks, methodologies, and toolkits used to scale global operations.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 152,000 USD – 230,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 7, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
